card.name: Author surnames in reference lists
card.fires_on: The first piece of an author's surname inside a citation or reference list, often split into parts, such as Palm, Gentle, Brand or Ha. It sits right after a comma, 'and' or initials.

modes.label: Surname start in citation
modes.description: The start of a surname that continues in the next piece, within a list of authors in a reference entry.
modes.example: 1. Ronca F,<< Palm>>ieri L, Panicucci P, Ron

modes.label: Editor or author lists
modes.description: A name in a textbook chapter citation, after 'In:' or among the editors.
modes.example: Endocrine tumors of the pancreas and gastrointestinal tract. In: Feldman M, Friedman LS,<< Brand>>t LJ, eds. Sleisenger

card.plain: It marks a surname being spelled out in a reference list, where more of the name follows.
